email_subject: Application - Flexi-job Social Media Content Creator
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Flexi-job Social Media Content Creator position at The ASH. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media integration, and SEO, I am excited about the opportunity to bring The ASH's unique atmosphere to life on Instagram and TikTok.

In my current role at Episto, I create and publish keyword-targeted content, manage WordPress sites, and track performance using analytics tools. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a website with integrated social media, and I regularly create engaging content for Instagram and Facebook. I am comfortable filming and editing with my smartphone, and I have experience with Canva and CapCut. I am also fluent in English and Dutch (B1), and I enjoy connecting with people from all over the world.

I am creative, trend-aware, and eager to contribute to The ASH's vibrant community. I would love to discuss how my skills can help grow your social media presence.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
